---
title: smalldocs 0.5.7
subtitle: api check can hold only what the pages show
date: 2026-11-11
author: Rahul Dave
categories: [release]
image: ../images/mark.svg
---

`smalldocs api check` has a new option, `--shown`. With it, `check` looks only at what the reference
pages show:

- the public functions and classes of each module. When a module has `__all__`, only the public names in it
- the public methods of each of these classes

So a private helper without a docstring is no longer a gap. A private name starts with `_`.

The setting `check-shown: true` in the `api` section of `_smalldocs.yml` does the same. A project can
then use it in its tests or in CI with no change to the command.

The option does not change the files of the `check` globs, such as the tests. They have no pages, so
`check` still looks at every name in them.

Without the option, `check` works as before. The pages do not change.
